The game result is provably fair.'); } else { setVerificationResult('❌ Verification failed! The game result may have been tampered with.'); } } }; return (

Provably Fair

Our Provably Fair system ensures that all game outcomes are verifiable and unbiased. You can verify that game results are not manipulated by the server.

{activeTab === 'coinflip' && (

Coinflip Provably Fair

Our coinflip system uses three components to ensure fairness:

  • Server Seed: A secret value generated by our server
  • Client Seed: A value provided by your browser
  • Nonce: A unique number incremented with each game

These three values are combined and hashed using SHA-256 to determine the outcome before the game begins. Since the server seed is hashed before you place your bet, the result cannot be manipulated.

)} {activeTab === 'blackjack' && (

Blackjack Provably Fair

Our blackjack system ensures a fair deck shuffle using provable fairness:

  • Server Seed: A secret value generated by our server
  • Client Seed: A value provided by your browser
  • Nonce: A unique number incremented with each game

The deck is shuffled using a cryptographically secure algorithm that combines these values, ensuring that neither the server nor the player can predict or manipulate the card order.

)} {activeTab === 'how-it-works' && (

How Provably Fair Works

  1. Before you play: The server generates a random Server Seed and provides you with its hash (this is the Commitment).
  2. During gameplay: The Client Seed (from your browser) and a Nonce (game counter) are combined with the Server Seed to determine the outcome.
  3. After gameplay: The server reveals the Server Seed. You can verify that it matches the hash provided before the game.
  4. Verification: Anyone can verify that the outcome was determined fairly using the three values.
